Washington Irving, The Sketchbook of Geoffrey Crayon, Gent.
Standard Ebooks edition: https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/washington-irving/the-sketchbook-of-geoffrey-crayon-gent

People whose words are in the text, and their death years:
- Washington Irving, the annotator, the author and the writer of the preface, died 1859 (Wikidata Q181667, P570 = 1859-11-28).

First publication of the text used: 1820 (SE colophon: 'The Sketchbook of Geoffrey Crayon, Gent. was published in 1820 by Washington Irving.')

Why this is public domain:
- United States: Standard Ebooks states that the text is in the United States public domain (its rights statement is quoted below). The text was first published in 1820, before 1931, so it entered the United States public domain 95 years after publication, in 1915.
- Country of origin: the facts do not name the country of first publication, and it does not change the result. Every person named above died in 1859 or earlier, the last being Washington Irving in 1859. The text is public domain in every country with a term of life plus 100 years or less, whatever its country of first publication.

They may still be copyrighted in other countries, so users located outside of the United States must check their local laws before using this ebook.
